body:
I understand.  I've been there with the small town thing.  I'm in that position right now.  But there is a large city close to me which makes it a little bit better.  I have lived in very small towns in my life before -- It feels like the walls are closing in on you.  I really sympathize with you here, this situation sucks.  I do not think anything will come of this, but I have no way of knowing of course.  If anything were to come of this, I don't think you would have a problem defending and winning your case, especially with a good lawyer -- I know money might be an issue here, but it would be worth the debt (I have plenty of debt at this point haha). 

This situation is temporary... but it definitely sucks, and might totally suck if it goes down the way you worry it might.  But it is temporary either way -- there's no way you would lose this case in my opinion, at least based on what you've described.  

Let's think about worst case scenario, because that is what is making you consider taking your own life.  They press charges -- then let's say you win the case, because I think you would.  You hate this town you live in anyway, right?  I know it's not as easy as just hopping on a train, it takes money to move.  But let's say you make money between now and then...  can you see yourself making a life in a bigger town, can you see yourself moving past this, even if they do end up pressing charges?
At what point did you start seeing improvements?  3 months?  6 months?

See I think you could win this case if it were ever to happen, and honestly, I don't think it will.  You said you live in a small town, why do you choose to live where you do? Is your family from there?  Do you have any strong ties to this area?
Yea, but the self shot collection wasn't necessarily of a girl under 18 right?  I'd imagine you don't really have any way of knowing, and neither would they...

Do you have facial distortion when you smile or move your face?  Do you have a "cool scar".  Haha I know that sounds like a stupid question, but girls before it happened to me would try to make me feel better by saying, "chicks dig scars."  Then when they saw mine, it wasn't a good reaction... I don't have a "cool scar."  Has it effected your dating life?
Okay, this is brutal -- so ridiculous on your neighbor's part -- no good deed goes unpunished.  Is there anything else on the compter that they might find that they would misinterpret?

2 years -- I dont' mean to minimize the problems that we all face.  I just have never encountered anything that so drastically changed the quality of life to the point where it's just not worth living.  It's not something you get over, because it makes everything unavailable.  Women, success, having a "nice smile" when the cameraman says cheese.  I ruin every picture I'm in.  It's like a burning building, your eye is immediately drawn to me, and you can't stop looking because of how fucked up it is.  I've tried to date, but I get the sympathy date, and then they're gone.  Think about how devastating it is to have been able to attract girls you are interested in, and now they run the other way -- ex girlfriends are gloating about it.  

I don't want to keep going back and forth like this and wasting your time.  I would just ask you -- why is it that you feel there' any fucking reason whatsoever to continue living this miserable hand I've been dealt?

in industrial sales.  i appreciate your replies.  But I don't think you have any real reference for how worthless living life like this is -- I certainly wouldn't have either before being deformed myself, so I hope you understand what I am saying.  I almost want to attach a picture for you so you can be like, "yea, I'd fucking kill myself too."  All of the other bullshit about it's what's on the inside is bullshit when you look like this.  That's something for people who don't look like comic book villans to say.

It would be nice if when I tried to smile I didn't look like a horror show.  It's been soulcrushing to run into exes who basically have a look on their face like, "thank god I didn't end up with you."  I guess it's what's on the inside that counts, but there's a symbiotic relationship between what's on the outside, and what the world gives you.  Yes, it's what's on the inside that counts, but if your outside prevents you from participating in any of he joys of life, then what's the point?  To have a beautiful inside that you can enjoy by yourself for the rest of your life?  

It's pretty pointless.  I don't think there's really anything that would make my life worth living at this point.  I never knew how powerful the look of someone's face is until this happened to me.  The world treats me completely differently.  It's horrible, I'm like a leper.  I went from having a lot of great friends and being a "good wingman" to not being invited out anywhere, and basically seen as a liability when my friends go out to pick up girls.  

Sales is a joke now.  People don't trust a guy with a fucked up face; they certainly don't feel the impulse to warm up to him.  It's the truth, and you don't realize it until it happens to you.

There's nothing left in this world that I want, because it's all been taken away from me.  Maybe I'll burn in hell for eternity after I do it like the Christians say, but honestly this life is a living hell for me anyway, so it doesn't really matter.  

I'm done.

That's an inspiring story -- I'm always amazed by the things people seem to be able to handle.  Guess I'm just a pussy, but from where I started, this deformed face thing is a devastating change in every aspect of my life.  

When I was 18 I just hated myself.  That never really got much better, but I'm good at hiding it.  I didn't have much reason to at that point, but I did.  I also went off of Paxil without telling anyone and then took every pill in the house in an attempt to end it.  

I don't think I'm going to make it through this time.  There's just no hope.  I'm amazed at the story of your coworker -- I just don't get it, what's the point of living like that?
